conversations.title: Explain missed-contact rate from the Analytics snapshot

turns.content: Why is missed-contact rate 166.7% and what changed versus last week?
Missed-contact rate is 166.7% because 5 unique missed conversations sat on 3 agent-demand conversations. That formula can exceed 100%. Top driver is no agents available.

conversations.title: Show hourly volume that supports peak hour

turns.content: Show me the historical contact volume by hour that supports 10:00-11:00 being the peak hour.
10:00-11:00 is the peak hour in Asia/Kolkata because org-wide forecast inbound is highest in that hour. Last 7 days had 9 actual conversations then versus 12 forecast.
